{{Otheruses|Feline}}
The '''''Feline''''' was a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B Escort Frigate]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the vessel was placed under command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vocis Kenit]] and assigned to the [[Ringali Shell]] in order to locate and destroy the mutinous [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]''.
